notes.title: Patch v1.1.14 hotfix
notes.content: Updated the linux repositories to change where libsteam_api.so is placed in the manifest to avoid an error.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.14
notes.content:
This is a patch to address potential issues with Anagrams granting achievements discussed here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1345940/discussions/0/592883708946609316/

Thanks fauxRIOT for notifying us of this issue!

notes.title: Tiny patch for Linux
notes.content:
Hello! This patch fixes a start up bug caused by the last update for Linux users only. 

Thank you to Mikhail_SaTuRn for reporting this!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.14
notes.content:
Hello! This patch changes the Puzzle Master & Anagram Master achievements from needing 1000 puzzles/anagrams to needing all the puzzles/anagrams in Classic Mode to be completed. It also adds additional checks to grant achievements that may have been missed due to this bug.

Thank you to user James & Michelle for lettings us know about this issue!

notes.title: v1.1.14
notes.content: This patch improves achievement grants for the BLITZNOVICE, BLITZMASTER, and BLITZEXPERT achievements.

notes.title: v1.1.13
notes.content: Improves the fix for the First Category achievement by adding a check on the categories screen.

notes.title: v1.1.12
notes.content:
v1.1.12

This small patch fixes a 'keycount' blue screen on the categories screen and an issue with granting the First Category achievement.

notes.title: v1.1.11
notes.content: This small update fixes nil value issues on the solve and play screens.

notes.title: v1.1.10
notes.content: This patch fixes a bug that caused Anagrams to crash on some systems when a match level is lost. Thanks again to t.kavanagh for reporting! :)

notes.title: v1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello!

This patch fixes a follow-up issue that certain players might experience when they try to replay a matching level by clicking "Retry". Thanks again for t.kavanagh for helping us identify this.

Thanks,
captainmaelstrom

notes.title: "Retry" button crash fix
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you t.kavanagh for reporting the following bug! When players clicked "Retry" after losing a match level, the game would crash. Although we weren't able to reproduce this bug, we believe this patch will fix it.

Thanks,
captainmaelstrom

notes.title: More tweaks for hard levels
notes.content: Just a few more tweaks for the hardest levels. Let us know if you still find these too difficult!

notes.title: Halloween Words + Game Difficulty Rebalancing
notes.content:
Halloween is almost upon us, and we've got some themed words to celebrate. Check out the new Halloween category (last category in the list)--it's already unlocked and ready to play! 

We've also included some tweaks to make Level 5 difficulty puzzles much less frustrating. If you were having trouble finishing categories before, give this update a shot and let us know what you think!

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Fixed steamworks issue
notes.content: Fixed an issue caused by Steamworks middleware

notes.title: v.1.0.5
notes.content:
This patch updates Anagrams to v.1.0.5

Bug Fixes:
* Finishing the a puzzle would send the player to the categories screen instead of the anagrams screen if all categories were unlocked

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content: * Fixed a bug where the game would error while matching tiles for a puzzle

notes.title: v1.0.3 update notes
notes.content:
Fixed an bug that could prevent players from getting the 'UNLOCKED' achievement.
Fixed a bug that could prevent swapping tiles after retrying a puzzle.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from clicking the 'back', 'help' or 'play' buttons if they had unlocked all categories and finished enough levels to get granted another key.

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content: This patch fixes some bugs for Blitz mode that were appearing on lower-end hardware. We'll be pushing more patches in the coming months to further optimize the game for low-end hardware.
